topic: Cursor acquired by SpaceX for $60B, brand retired and absorbed into Grok — the dev tool that taught a generation to ship with AI is gone
tweet_text:
Cursor is dead.

SpaceX bought them for $60B — biggest startup deal ever — and is retiring the name.

Four MIT classmates. 3 years. $2.6B ARR. Now Grok.

The tool that taught a generation to ship with AI… gone.

Wild week to be shipping in this space.

#AI #Cursor
concept: A single tiny glowing terminal caret cursor on a vast dim monitor, dwarfed and eclipsed by a colossal rocket exhaust trail blazing diagonally across the upper frame — the intimate developer tool being overwhelmed by something massive and unstoppable.
